metadata.question: On August 2, 2018, did the water temperature at Long Beach (33.601421, -118.089042) show a higher temperature anomaly, when compared to the long-term average for this time of year, than that observed at Pismo Beach (35.128348, -120.727924)?

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection size; if 0 after trying both datasets => C1.
- Check band presence ('anom', 'sst'); if missing => D.
- Count valid pixels in buffered area; if 0 => C2.
- If anomaly is null or outside plausible range (|anom| > 20 C or sst out of [0, 40]) => C3.

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const lbPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.089042, 33.601421]); // Long Beach
    const pbPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.727924, 35.128348]); // Pismo Beach
    const start = '2018-08-02';
    const end = '2018-08-03';
    const bufferMeters = 25000; // coarse L4 grid, buffer to ensure coverage
    const scale = 25000;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback dataset IDs
    const datasetIds = ['NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2', 'NOAA/OISST/V2'];
    let usedId = null;
    let col = null;
    let size = 0;

    for (const id of datasetIds) {
      try {
        const tmpCol = ee.ImageCollection(id).filterDate(start, end);
        const tmpSize = await tmpCol.size().getInfo();
        if (tmpSize > 0) {
          usedId = id;
          col = tmpCol;
          size = tmpSize;
          break;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Try next dataset
      }
    }

    if (!usedId) {
      console.log('Dataset error or unavailable for all tried IDs.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }

    if (size === 0) {
      console.log(`Images: 0 for ${usedId} on ${start}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const firstImg = ee.Image(col.first());
    const bands = await firstImg.bandNames().getInfo();
    const hasAnom = bands && bands.indexOf('anom') !== -1;
    const hasSst = bands && bands.indexOf('sst') !== -1;
    if (!hasAnom || !hasSst) {
      console.log(`Band check failed. Bands: ${JSON.stringify(bands)}`);
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }

    const img = firstImg.select(['anom', 'sst']);

    async function statsAtPoint(pt) {
      const geom = pt.buffer(bufferMeters);
      const meanDict = await img
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9,
          bestEffort: true
        })
        .getInfo();

      const countDict = await img
        .select('anom')
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9,
          bestEffort: true
        })
        .getInfo();

      const anom = meanDict ? meanDict.anom : null;
      const sst = meanDict ? meanDict.sst : null;
      const count = countDict ? countDict.anom : 0;
      return { anom, sst, count };
    }

    const lb = await statsAtPoint(lbPoint);
    const pb = await statsAtPoint(pbPoint);

    // 3. Processing validations (C2, C3)
    if ((lb.count || 0) === 0 || (pb.count || 0) === 0) {
      console.log(`Pixel count LB: ${lb.count || 0}, PB: ${pb.count || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const invalid =
      lb.anom === null || pb.anom === null || lb.sst === null || pb.sst === null ||
      !isFinite(lb.anom) || !isFinite(pb.anom) || !isFinite(lb.sst) || !isFinite(pb.sst) ||
      Math.abs(lb.anom) > 20 || Math.abs(pb.anom) > 20 ||
      lb.sst < 0 || lb.sst > 40 || pb.sst < 0 || pb.sst > 40;

    if (invalid) {
      console.log('Invalid values encountered (null/NaN/out-of-range).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Output concise evidence and final answer
    console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}; Images: ${size}; Date: ${start}`);
    console.log(`Long Beach anom(C): ${lb.anom.toFixed(2)}, sst(C): ${lb.sst.toFixed(2)}, pix: ${lb.count}`);
    console.log(`Pismo Beach anom(C): ${pb.anom.toFixed(2)}, sst(C): ${pb.sst.toFixed(2)}, pix: ${pb.count}`);
    const diff = lb.anom - pb.anom;
    console.log(`Anomaly difference (LB - PB): ${diff.toFixed(2)} C`);

    // 5. Final Answer: A if LB anomaly > PB anomaly, else B
    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
